title: MEIKO — Feasting Like A Queen!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was hoping to sing with Miku if I found her...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But she doesn't seem to be here either.)
Is something wrong, MEIKO?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, Luka!
Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm looking for Miku. Do you happen to know where she is?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... Miku went over to take a look at those other SEKAI a second ago.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She just left, so it may be a little while before she returns.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll wait here for her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku's been visiting those other SEKAI quite a lot lately, hasn't she?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe she's worried about everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Worried?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Remember the black fragments of feelings that have been appearing? She may be concerned about something else happening in those SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that was very surprising for all of us, too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thinking about it, the strangest things seem to happen in those SEKAI specifically, don't they?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The black fragments of feelings are one thing... But new areas appearing, and trees that grow with people's feelings? Those are strange, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Watching over them has been a bit of an adventure.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it has. It's been a bit nerve-wracking at times.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, what if we did this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's take a minute to imagine what could happen in their SEKAI. That should help you feel a little less scared!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What could happen?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So we imagine what might happen so it doesn't feel so overwhelming?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right! For example...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, imagine the flying train from Tsukasa's SEKAI arriving at the station in Ichika and the girls' SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! That'd be an extraordinary event!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's less an event that could happen, and more an event that would cause a huge commotion.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't you two come up with some examples?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we envision things that are a little over the top, we should be able to handle whatever does end up happening in a cool and calm manner, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be able to say, “It's not as bad as what we imagined.” See?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-I see...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see your logic.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right? So, let's think together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
There's a lake in Mafuyu's SEKAI, and a pond in Minori and her group's SEKAI, yes?
So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if peering into the water in one SEKAI let you see the faces of people from the other SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! That's a wonderful example!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, but... Seeing the face of someone else instead of your own would be a little scary. It's sort of like a horror film.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I don't think it'd be scary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Imagine two people who were never supposed to meet, encountering each other across space and time. Doesn't that sound romantic?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that is another way of looking at it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, Luka, how about you?
Have you come up with any outlandish happenings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well... Oh, in Kohane and her team's SEKAI, they have alleys where you can hear music.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if that music turned into idol or rock songs one sudden day?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what would happen next?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those alleyways would end up connected to Minori and her group's SEKAI and Ichika and her band's SEKAI. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I like it! That actually sounds a bit exciting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
The thought of music helping you meet others is a wonderful idea...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, huh? Aren't we getting a little off topic?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I just thought of another one!
It has to do with the SEKAI where I run a cafe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We came up with quite a lot of ideas!
That was really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... What began as mental preparation sort of turned into coming up with the funniest scenarios.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we came up with so many ideas for things that would actually be lots of fun if they happened that I'm actually looking forward to what might happen next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too!
And the discussion did make me think...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whatever does end up happening, I'm sure they'll be able to handle it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: New areas appearing in each SEKAI and those black fragments of feelings appearing were both startling developments...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But everyone made it through just fine in the end.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, even if something beyond our wildest imaginings does happen, they should have no problem overcoming it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're right, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Their feelings have grown stronger than we could've ever imagined in the beginning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep believing in the strength of their feelings as we watch over them moving forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!
